spec.expr: label_set((sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_pv_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month)) /1000, "series", "光伏发电") or label_set((sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_grid_import_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month)) /1000, "series", "电网输入") or label_set(((sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_home_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month)) * -1) /1000, "series", "家庭") or label_copy(((sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_loadpoint_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}",loadpoint!~"$loadpointBlocklist"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month, loadpoint)) * -1) /1000, "loadpoint", "series") or label_set(((sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_grid_export_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month)) * -1) /1000, "series", "馈电")

spec.title: 单位收益
spec.description: Annual PV yield normalized to installed kWp. Uses investment asset watt_peak values when available and falls back to installedWattPeak.

spec.expr:
WITH (
  gridImport = running_sum(sum(last_over_time(evcc_grid_import_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))),
  homeEnergy = running_sum(sum(last_over_time(evcc_home_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))),
  loadpointEnergy = running_sum(sum(last_over_time(evcc_loadpoint_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d])) or vector(0))
)
clamp_max(clamp_min(1 - gridImport / clamp_min(homeEnergy + loadpointEnergy, 0.001), 0), 1)

WITH (
  pvEnergy = running_sum(sum(last_over_time(evcc_pv_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))),
  gridExport = running_sum(sum(last_over_time(evcc_grid_export_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d])))
)
clamp_max(clamp_min((pvEnergy - gridExport) / clamp_min(pvEnergy, 0.001), 0), 1)

WITH (
  greenShare = sum(last_over_time(evcc_green_share_home_daily_ratio{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d])),
  sumGreenShare = running_sum(greenShare),
  countGreenShare = running_sum((greenShare * 0) + 1)
)
sumGreenShare / clamp_min(countGreenShare, 1)

WITH (
  gridImport = sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_grid_import_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month),
  homeEnergy = sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_home_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month),
  loadpointEnergy = (sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_loadpoint_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month)) or (homeEnergy * 0),
  pvEnergy = sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_pv_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month),
  gridExport = sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_grid_export_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month),
  greenShareSum = sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_green_share_home_daily_ratio{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month),
  greenShareCount = sum(count_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_green_share_home_daily_ratio{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month),
  autarky = label_set(1 - gridImport / clamp_min(homeEnergy + loadpointEnergy, 0.001), "series", "自给率"),
  selfConsumption = label_set((pvEnergy - gridExport) / pvEnergy, "series", "自耗"),
  greenShare = label_set(greenShareSum / clamp_min(greenShareCount, 1), "series", "绿色占比")
)
autarky or selfConsumption or greenShare

WITH (
  other = label_set((sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_home_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month) - sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_ext_energy_daily_wh{title!="",title!~"$extBlocklist",local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month)) / 1000, "series", "其他"),
  ext = label_copy((sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_ext_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}",title!="",title!~"$extBlocklist"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month, title)) / 1000, "title", "series"),
  aux = label_copy((sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_aux_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}",title!="",title!~"$auxBlocklist"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month, title)) / 1000, "title", "series")
)
other or ext or aux

WITH (
  batteryNet = ((sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_battery_charge_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month)) - (sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_battery_discharge_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month))) / 1000,
  batteryCharge = label_set((batteryNet > 0), "series", "电池充电"),
  batteryDischarge = label_set((batteryNet < 0), "series", "电池放电"),
  home = label_set((sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_home_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month)) / 1000, "series", "家庭"),
  loadpoints = label_copy((sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_loadpoint_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}",loadpoint!~"$loadpointBlocklist"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month, loadpoint)) / 1000, "loadpoint", "series")
)
home or sort_by_label(loadpoints, "series") or batteryCharge or batteryDischarge

  discharge = label_set(sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_battery_discharge_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month) / 1000, "series", "放电")

spec.title: 热泵总量
spec.description: 匹配负载点上的年度热泵能耗。

spec.title: 热泵来源占比
spec.description: 热泵负载点的光伏、电池放电和电网供电估算占比。

spec.title: 充电桩总量
spec.description: 可见充电负载点的年度充电能耗，不含热泵负载点。

spec.title: 充电桩来源占比
spec.description: 可见充电负载点的光伏、电池放电和电网供电估算占比，不含热泵。

spec.title: 车辆
spec.description: 消费数据需要数月后才有意义。外部充电被忽略，会扭曲结果。

spec.title: 每月行驶公里
spec.description: 只有在车辆接入时才会记录公里数。如果接入频率较低，公里数可能会缺失。

spec.title: 能耗 (kWh/100km)
spec.description: 这些值为近似值。不包含外部充电，记录到的公里数取决于车辆接入的频率。

spec.title: 光伏发电成本
spec.description: 按光伏来源显示基于投资的年度光伏发电成本以及加权总计。低于 1 kWh 已映射年度光伏发电量的值会被省略。不包含电池和电网成本。

spec.title: 每周光伏发电成本 (ct/kWh)
spec.description: 按光伏来源显示滚动 7 天的光伏发电成本。仅当 7 天窗口包含超过 1 kWh 的已映射光伏发电量时才显示。不包含电池和电网成本。

spec.title: PV specific yield (kWh/kWp)
spec.description: Annual PV yield normalized by installed kWp per PV source. Values are generated by the investment helper from mapped PV energy and watt_peak metadata; the selected year panel includes partial years with the coverage shown in the legend.

spec.title: PV specific yield/week (kWh/kWp)
spec.description: Rolling 7-day PV yield normalized by installed kWp per PV source. Values are generated by the investment helper and shown only when the 7-day window contains more than 1 kWh mapped PV energy.
